title_zh: 反馈研讨课提速并约定增加提问停顿

scenario.label_zh: 研讨课节奏反馈与调整
scenario.goal_zh: 说明本周课程节奏明显加快及练习不足，约定下次课每个例子后留出提问时间

context_zh: 成人课程学员向讲师反馈本周研讨课节奏。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Could we talk about the seminar? This week felt significantly faster than the first one.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: I covered more examples, so that is useful to hear. Where did you lose track?

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: After the second example. There was no time to try the method before you moved on.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: That is a significant change from last week, when we paused after each example. I should not have removed all those pauses.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Could we have a moment for questions in the next session, even if it means fewer examples?

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Yes. I will pause after each example, let you try the step, and take questions before moving on.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: That sounds better. I would rather understand two examples than rush through four.
